influences.name: Brian Wilson
influences.context: After meeting Brian Wilson in 1963 and 1964, Jan and Dean achieved the pinnacle of their commercial success. Berry and Wilson worked together on a dozen songs and album cuts for Jan and Dean, including 'Surf City,' which was co-written by Jan Berry and Brian Wilson

influences.name: the Beach Boys
influences.context: They met and performed with the Beach Boys while playing local venues, and they found the appeal of the latter's 'surf sound.'

influences.name: The Beatles
influences.context: Of course, The Beatles helped. The Beatles finally had control over their graphic design, and then of course once that happened, all artists wanted control.

influences.name: Peter, Paul and Mary
influences.context: I enjoyed folk music, and I liked Peter, Paul and Mary's stuff, and I noticed they were using the same font, the same lettering, on multiple covers, and I went, boy that's interesting. They're treating their career as a real business, with real branding, and they're doing their branding by using that type style, which was kind of a folk, hippie type style. I thought that was really brilliant.
